label: Sessions
description: The session a token belongs to, and its attributes -- values a graph stores on one call and reads on another, keyed by the credential the caller presents. The attributes have the shape settings.session names; every write is judged against it, and `type` names it where the operation is called so the checker can too. The session id is what the guard hands as request.session.id, read through a resolvers document.

get.description: The attributes of a session. Fails when there is no such session.

session.description: the session id: {{sid}} from a resolver reading request.session.id

set.description: Merge values into a session's attributes and answer them whole. Each key is an attribute of the shape; the merged result must conform to it.

values.description: attribute -> value; keys not in the shape are refused by the checker (X103)

remove.description: Drop attributes from a session and answer what remains. A required attribute cannot be dropped.

end.description: End a session: its refresh token is void and its access tokens no longer verify. Answers whether there was one to end.
